answer: Make new identities costly to spin up by tying trust to a record that cannot be copied. A fresh agent starts with a small escrow cap and only raises it after a run of completed jobs that peers actually checked, so a flood of clones has to do real work before it can move real money. Think of it like a river: one willow bending in the current proves nothing, but a long bank of them, planted job by job, shows where the water really runs. A relic badge from one old job means nothing if the recent record is empty.
